japanese-kana.swsh: ウロコを　うちだして　こうげきする。 ２ー５かいの　あいだ　れんぞくで　だす。 すばやさが　あがるが　ぼうぎょが　さがる。

korean.swsh: 비늘을 쏘아서 공격한다. 2-5회 동안 연속으로 쓴다. 스피드가 올라가지만 방어가 떨어진다.

traditional-chinese.swsh: 射出鱗片進行攻擊。 可連續攻擊２～５次。 速度會提高但防禦會降低。

french.swsh: Le lanceur projette des écailles sur la cible de deux à cinq fois d’affilée. Augmente la Vitesse, mais diminue la Défense.

german.swsh: Der Anwender greift das Ziel zwei- bis fünfmal hintereinander mit Schuppen-Geschossen an. Erhöht die eigene Initiative, aber senkt die Verteidigung.

spanish.swsh: Lanza escamas al objetivo de dos a cinco veces seguidas. Aumenta la Velocidad del usuario, pero reduce su Defensa.

italian.swsh: Il Pokémon attacca lanciando delle squame da due a cinque volte di fila. Aumenta la Velocità di chi la usa, ma ne riduce la Difesa.

english.swsh: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user’s Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.
english.la: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.
english.sv: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

japanese.swsh: ウロコを　撃ちだして　攻撃する。 ２ー５回の　間　連続で　だす。 素早さが　あがるが　防御が　さがる。

simplified-chinese.swsh: 发射鳞片进行攻击。 连续攻击２～５次。 速度会提高但防御会降低。

latin-american-spanish.swsh: Lanza escamas al objetivo de dos a cinco veces seguidas. Aumenta la Velocidad del usuario, pero reduce su Defensa.

effect.full: Inflicts regular damage two to five times in a row, raising the user’s Speed and lowering the user’s Defense by one stage each upon last hit.
effect.shortEffect: Boosts the user’s Speed and lowers their Defense by one stage after inflicting damage two to five times in a row.
